metas.name: Golmaal Again
metas.description:
★ 5.4 · 2017
Gopal and his best friends are back again, and this time they move back to their old neighborhood in a new palatial house where they learn that it is being haunted by a ghost.

metas.name: Maine Pyaar Kyun Kiya?
metas.description:
★ 5.4 · 2005
Dr Samir is an absolute charmer when it comes to women, but he poses as a married man to keep them at bay. Love becomes a three-ring-circus for him after he ends up tangled in his web of lies with his girlfriend…

metas.name: Judwaa 2
metas.description:
★ 5.3 · 2017
Separated at birth and peculiarly connected via their reflexes, twins Prem and Raja are reunited with each other as they set out to take down the underground smuggling world.

metas.name: Loev
metas.description:

When hot shot, Wall Street dealmaker Jai thinks of putting some pleasure into his 48 hour business trip to Mumbai, Sahil, his young, music-producer friend, drops everything, including his reckless boyfriend Alex, to…

metas.name: Bodyguard
metas.description:
★ 5.3 · 2011
Lovely Singh is extremely respectful of Mr Rana and his daughter Divya. While appointed as Divya's bodyguard, he falls in love with a girl he has never met, unaware that she is none other than Divya.

metas.name: Tubelight
metas.description:
★ 5.3 · 2017
Laxman Singh Bisht is nicknamed tube light by his neighbours because he is feeble-minded. Despite being special, Laxman lives by one life-lesson; keep your faith alive and you can do almost anything, even stop a war.

metas.name: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
metas.description:
★ 5.3 · 2015
While recovering from an assassination attempt four days before his coronation, a stern prince is replaced by a romantic lookalike.

metas.name: Zero
metas.description:
★ 5.2 · 2018
Short in stature but big on love, a bachelor meets two very different women who broaden his horizons and help him find purpose in life.

metas.name: Housefull 3
metas.description:
★ 5.1 · 2016
A father doesn't want his three daughters to get married. Now, it's up to three men to try to and convince the father that they're a good fit for his daughters.

metas.name: Ready
metas.description:
★ 5.1 · 2011
Prem believes Sanjana is the girl chosen by his dad and falls in love with her. However, she is a runaway bride escaping from a marriage set up by her mafia uncles against her wishes. On learning the truth, he…

metas.name: Dabangg 2
metas.description:
★ 5.0 · 2012
Chulbul Pandey invites a fresh trouble when he kills the brother of a notorious politician and the former swears to wreak havoc in his life.

metas.name: Jai Ho
metas.description:
★ 5.0 · 2014
An upright ex-army man, Jai fights a solitary war against corruption and injustice. With a simple mantra to pay forward, he starts off by helping one person and forms an ever growing circle of people helping each other.

metas.name: Gunday
metas.description:
★ 4.8 · 2014
The lives of Calcutta's most powerful gangsters - Bikram and Bala, changes when Nandita enters it. Then a counter-force takes charge and a thriller unfolds.

metas.name: Tees Maar Khan
metas.description:

A con artist poses as a film director in a village with the intention of executing a caper with the unwitting help of the villagers.
